turns.assessment: The simultaneous OSC loss on the spans immediately adjacent to S20 in both directions of S20–S01 and S20–S13, together with downstream amplifier input LOS, is strong evidence of a physical multi-cable cut near S20. It is not consistent with a client, transponder, amplifier, OTN-switch, or WSS fault, especially because OSC is lost. The evidence does not identify either named span as the single initiating element; a shared-duct excavation likely cut both, so no individual proposal reaches the 80% commitment threshold.

proposals.rationale: O107 reports OSC loss on the first S20→S01 span, while O103/O105 show corresponding loss from the reverse fibre. A cable cut here explains the hard bidirectional loss; the simultaneous S20–S13 loss could be collateral damage to another cable in the same duct.
